units.source_text: 好久没有一个人干活了，女人脸上疲劳的神色果然加深了。

en.t: It had been a long time since she had worked alone, and the fatigue on the woman's face had indeed deepened.

units.source_text: 女人本来就慌慌张张地准备着迟到的晚饭，他还要故意问这问那纠缠她。

en.t: The woman was already hurrying in a fluster to prepare the late supper, but he deliberately kept pestering her with one question after another.

units.source_text: 最后他还主动提出修理一下一直不太好用的水槽。

en.t: In the end, he even volunteered to repair the sink that had never worked very well.

units.source_text: 也许女人觉得男人的任性是准备在此生根的标志吧，也生怕坏了他的好情绪，女人脸上没有露出一点为难的神色。

en.t: Perhaps the woman took the man's willfulness as a sign that he was ready to settle down here, and because she was afraid of spoiling his good mood, she did not let the slightest look of difficulty show on her face.

units.source_text: 活一干完，怎么都想洗个澡。

en.t: Once the work was finished, he wanted a bath no matter what.

units.source_text: 特别是让汗水湿透的皮肤沾上沙子的感觉，实在让人受不住……

en.t: Especially the feeling of sand sticking to skin soaked with sweat was truly unbearable...

units.source_text: 正好又是送来配给洗澡用水的日子，而且女人特别喜欢洗男人的身体，肯定不会拒绝。

en.t: It also happened to be the day when the rationed bath water was delivered, and since the woman especially liked washing the man's body, she surely would not refuse.
